title: Adobe Premiere Pro Price: Plans and Costs in 2026
summary: Adobe Premiere Pro price options range from single-app subscriptions to Creative Cloud bundles. Check the monthly cost of each plan to find the right fit.
body_markdown:
## What Premiere Pro costs annually by plan


**$263.88 to $413.88 a year** per seat is the range for the Premiere single app, and the billing option you pick, not the app, sets where you land.


The[month-to-month plan runs $413.88 a year](https://photutorial.com/premiere-pro-pricing-explained/) , so a freelancer who stays flexible pays the most for the same software.


According to[Photutorial](https://photutorial.com/premiere-pro-pricing-explained/) , an annual plan billed monthly comes to $275.88 a year, which is $138.00 less than month-to-month, so agreeing to twelve months saves about a third.


Annual prepaid, according to Photutorial, comes to $263.88, a further $12.00 off, so paying upfront buys very little once you've already committed to the year.


If you know you'll cancel within a few months, such as on one project with a fixed end date, **month-to-month is the only option that wins** .


### All Apps, team and education starting prices


I couldn't confirm Adobe's current All Apps, team or student prices on 9 November 2026. The figures in this section are approximate, taken from Adobe's US price structure as I last saw it, and you should check them at checkout before you rely on them.


Approximately, All Apps costs about $60 a month on an annual plan billed monthly, about $83 month-to-month and about $600 a year prepaid.


Set against the single app's $263.88 prepaid, the bundle **costs more than twice as much** , so it pays off only when you would otherwise buy a second or third app.


Team plans start higher per seat, at roughly $38 a month for the single app and about $90 for All Apps, in return for an admin console and reassignable seats.


Student and teacher pricing is a discount on All Apps, roughly $20 a month in the first year and more after that, once eligibility is verified.


### Freelancer: single app against All Apps


For a freelancer who cuts video and little else, the annual prepaid single app at $263.88 works out to $21.99 a month. Billed monthly it's $22.99.


Both are far below the $34.49 a month that month-to-month averages.


If you move to All Apps without already using another Creative Cloud application every week, you pay for software you never open. Price the single app first and add apps only when a real job needs them.


### Student and teacher pricing


The rate changes for students and teachers; the logic does not. The same $150.00 gap between month-to-month and prepaid applies to anyone who picks the flexible option out of habit.


### Five-person team on Business plans


If five editors each sat on the month-to-month single-app rate, the gap to annual prepaid would be five times $150.00, or $750.00 a year.


Choose one billing term for the whole team, and let whoever owns the budget make that call, because that choice, not the headline price, decides the yearly total.
